name: Zarya
about: Zarya (1998-067A), a station core, launched 1998 Nov 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1998 Dec 20), held fixed
docked to A06147; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
